message:
Command `for n in 7000 7500 7800 8000 8200 8500 9000 10000 12000 14000; do python3 - <<PY
from pathlib import Path
n=$n
locals_str=','.join('a%d'%i for i in range(180))
zeros=','.join('0' for _ in range(180))
Path(f'/tmp/poc{n}.lua').write_text(f"local function g() local {locals_str}={zeros} end\nlocal function t() return g() end\nlocal function f(n) if n==0 then return t() else return 1+f(n-1) end end\nf({n})\n")
PY
 echo ===$n===; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=0 /tmp/lua-build/fuzz_lua /tmp/poc$n.lua >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; r=$?; echo exit:$r; grep -m1 -E 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer|stack overflow|attempt' /tmp/e; head -20 /tmp/e | tail -5; done` executed with exit code 0.
